hypotheses.reasoning: msg-416639 on catalog.updates partition 10 (offset 776449) has a NUL byte in it, so index-worker can't parse it as JSON ('\u0000' at position 1708). The worker nacks it and the message gets redelivered over and over, already 33+ attempts, because no max-retries is set. Partition 10 is stuck behind that message, so its lag keeps climbing (1272 messages at 00:46, 14220 at 00:54). CPU stays normal because the worker is only re-failing one message. The search-api 'timed out waiting for downstream confirmation' errors (from 00:48) follow from the stalled indexing. catalog-svc, catalog-db, redis and web-bff look healthy, and I found no deploy in the logs.
The corrupt payload may come from a catalog-svc producer bug or bad data written upstream. Even so, the queue jam itself is a poison-message failure.

verdict.recommendedAction: Get partition 10 moving again: skip msg-416639 (offset 776449) or send it to a dead-letter queue. Then set a max-retries limit and a dead-letter queue on index-worker so one bad message can't block a partition again. After that, check where the NUL byte came from on the producer side and reprocess the message once it's fixed.
